root_cause.text: The `check_command_size_in_blocks()` function in the USB mass storage gadget driver performs a left-shift operation on `common->data_size_from_cmnd` by `common->curlun->blkbits` without validating whether the operation will cause an integer overflow.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that the direct shift `common->data_size_from_cmnd <<= common->curlun->blkbits;` is replaced with a check using `check_shl_overflow(common->data_size_from_cmnd, common->curlun->blkbits, &common->data_size_from_cmnd)` to catch overflows and return `-EINVAL`.
